thread:
ingrid: Heads-up — planning to shrink the v2 change window for EU to tomorrow 09:00-10:00 UTC. Quiet rollout: 10% for 1h then 30% if stable. Mobile SDK teams need pin criteria and release note blurb.

santosh: SGTM. Can we enforce fallback via header gate? prefer to keep X-Redwood-Client-Version gating for a week.

maria: I can push the telemetry checks. propose pin window = 48h (not 72). we have last 48h of client usage data.

alex: checklist: deploy-bot preflight, canary 10%, watch error-rate, 429 spike, latency p50/p95, model fallback rate, and client pin signals.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started canary: project=api gateway env=eu-west-1 direction=v2 canary=10% id=deploy-1724500000

ingrid: rollback triggers proposal: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 3m OR 429 rate > 2% for 10m OR client-pinned v1 traffic > 1% for any 15m.

santosh: add mobile-specific trigger: if mobile SDK pin events (x-client-pin=v1) exceed 2% of mobile traffic for 15m, abort canary and roll back.

maria: metrics query I'm adding to alerting:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="eu-west-1",route="/v2"} [5m])) by (status)
```
and a query for header pin events: `sum(increase(client_pin_events_total[15m])) / sum(increase(http_requests_total{client_type="mobile"}[15m]))`

alex: release notes snippet draft for SDKs:
"Tomorrow 09:00-10:00 UTC we will begin a limited v2 rollout in EU. v2 uses header `X-Redwood-Api-Version: 2`. If you rely on v1 behaviour pin by sending `X-Redwood-Api-Version: 1` and open a support ticket. Rollback criteria are documented in the infra runbook."

ingrid: @samir can you pre-signal mobile partners and get ack from top 3 customers? if we don't get ack we hold.

samir: on it. pinging top-3 now, will update thread within 30m.

maria: I'm creating the alert groups and a short dashboard; will post link when ready.

deploy-bot: canary health check: 10% -> ok (lat50 110ms, errors 0.08%) — continuing monitoring

ingrid: action items: samir = partner pings, maria = alerts/dashboard, alex = rollback doc update, santosh = header-gate patch. We'll reconvene at T-1h in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
